summary: Tested new Task module (backend + frontend) and backward-compat endpoints. 18/20 pytest cases pass. All 6 legacy modules (auth/me, dashboard/stats, projects, employees, leads, quotations-adv) return 200. Frontend /tasks renders correctly (Kanban + Table + tabs + filters + New task form with vendor-specific fields on Vendor tab); /tasks/:id detail page loads with Overview/Follow-ups/Timeline/References tabs.

critical.issue: Passing only 'status' (lane) has no effect when the task already has a 'status_detail'. In routes/tasks.py update_task_status(), the code sets merged['status']=lane then calls _sync_status_from_detail(merged) which prefers status_detail and rewrites the lane back. Kanban drag-drop from a task that has a granular status_detail will silently NOT change the column. Repro: create task with status_detail='Selection Required' (lane=todo), PATCH /status {status:'in_progress'} → response has status='todo'. Fix: when only 'lane' is supplied, either (a) clear status_detail, or (b) set status_detail = LANE_TO_DEFAULT_STATUS[lane] BEFORE calling _sync_status_from_detail, or (c) skip re-sync when the lane was explicitly passed in.

Fields 'attachments', 'reference_links', 'assignees' are returned as null (not []) when task was created without them. In routes/tasks.py create_task() uses doc.setdefault(...) AFTER payload.model_dump() which already inserted None for optional list fields, so setdefault is a no-op. GET also uses setdefault so null persists. Frontend code that does `t.attachments.length` will crash on such tasks. Fix: replace setdefault with `if not doc.get(k): doc[k] = []` for attachments/reference_links/assignees on both create + get.

integration_issues.flow: Kanban drag-drop for tasks that have status_detail
integration_issues.issue: Because PATCH /tasks/{id}/status with only 'status' is a no-op when status_detail is present (see backend bug), moving such cards between Kanban columns will optimistically update the UI but the server keeps the original lane. On next reload the card jumps back. Fix backend first; frontend appears correct.

issues: Date inputs use the browser's native <input type='date'> (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of a shadcn/calendar component — inconsistent with rest of the design system and per project guidelines.

TaskDetail page 'Back to tasks' link has no data-testid='task-detail-back'; 'References' tab has no data-testid='tab-references'. These are the only two missing testids compared to the spec. Non-blocking but recommended to add for test stability.

action_items: Fix PATCH /tasks/{id}/status so that supplying only a lane actually changes the lane when the task already has a status_detail (Kanban drag-drop bug).
Ensure list fields (attachments, reference_links, assignees) are always [] not null on create + get responses.
Add data-testid='task-detail-back' to the back button and data-testid='tab-references' to the References tab in TaskDetail.jsx.
Consider swapping native <input type='date'> for the shadcn Calendar/DatePicker used elsewhere.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/tasks.py update_task() correctly appends to timeline via $push — good, timeline is never deleted (satisfies the audit requirement).

routes/tasks.py list_tasks(): the search block overwrites/extends q['$or'] but a preceding assignee_id filter also sets $or; if both search and assignee_id are supplied Mongo will merge them into a single $or which loosens the AND semantic. Consider using $and or separate $or arrays. Not exercised by current UI.
models/task.py: LANE_TO_DEFAULT_STATUS['review']='Inspection Pending' but STATUS_TO_LANE['On Hold']='review' as well — reverse mapping loses info. Acceptable but document.
core/deps.py require_user() is called in every route; consider FastAPI dependency injection for cleaner code.
